children: Russia’s annual inflation rate edged up to 6.35% in September 2026 from 6.33% in the previous month.
Services inflation accelerated to 7.97% from 7.85%, while food price growth eased to 5.05% from 5.08% and non-food inflation slowed to 6.47% from 6.51%.

Within food prices, fruit and vegetable prices continued to decline year-on-year, falling 4.24% compared with 5.19% in August, while food products excluding fruits and vegetables rose 5.24% (vs 5.15%).
Core inflation increased to 5.47% from 5.37% in the previous month.
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose by 0.35% in September, following a 0.08% decline in August. Average inflation for January–September reached 5.93%, up from 5.87% in the January–August period.

title: Russia Inflation Rate Edges Up in September
